mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 730000) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 325.0), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0) compresses equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 325.0, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 101.0) signals expanding economic output, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1250.0 units indicates strong residential demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST > 1250.0 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 159000) defines a tight labor market that boosts corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 159000 does not produce positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 indicates economic contraction, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
